issues.issue: Whether the grandfather could locate or harm the appellants in Port Harcourt or Ibadan
issues.applicant_position: Appellants did not challenge the RPD's finding of no risk in Port Harcourt or Ibadan.
issues.result_text: Appellants have no well-founded fear or risk of harm in Port Harcourt or Ibadan.

issues.issue: Whether relocation to Port Harcourt or Ibadan is objectively unreasonable
issues.applicant_position: RPD ignored country documents on language, cost of living, employment and accommodation difficulties in those cities.
issues.result_text: Relocation is not unduly harsh; Port Harcourt and Ibadan are viable internal flight alternatives.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD misconstrued the principal appellant's reason for going to Qatar
issues.applicant_position: RPD misconstrued his testimony: he went to Qatar because he could not find work in Nigeria.
issues.result_text: RAD agrees with the testimony point, but the error is not determinative of the IFA issue.

issues.issue: Whether the RPD raised the standard of proof and wrongly dismissed country documents on security
issues.applicant_position: RPD raised the standard of proof and wrongly treated security documents as irrelevant.
issues.result_text: Standard argument lacks particulars; security documents concern other regions and times.
